hierarchy: 1 real photos/archival (license-verified only) · 2 ink reconstructions, on-screen labelled · 3 evidence typographic cards · 4 real-data terrain plates (SRTM via Mapzen, CC-BY)

b1a.why: Opens on the documented 26 Feb 1959 discovery: standing tent, slit from inside, belongings in place. Photo slot only if Commons licence verified; fallback is a labelled ink tent with three visible cuts. No gore, no staged fake-1959 imagery.

b1b.why: The protocol fact: 8-9 print trails walking (not running) to the treeline, some in socks. Chip annotations: SOCKS / SINGLE BOOTS. Prints stop at forest edge — the question's visual seed.

b1b2.why: Absence-of-planning triad: NO SUPPLIES / NO NOTE / NO PREPARED TRAIL. Keeps the hook factual and sets the exit's suddenness before the question lands.

b1c.why: Night grade over the real SRTM relief of the slope; falling snow. Chip: FAR BELOW −30°C (SEARCHER RECORDS). No invented station data — qualitative per ledger.

b1d.why: The operator's thumbnail line WHY DID THEY LEAVE? becomes the hook slam — crimson on black, case-file mono. Ties film to thumbnail concept.

b1e.why: DYATLOV PASS / THE UNCLOSED FILE — brand moment (poster frame source).

b2a.why: Sverdlovsk marker on real relief corridor; card: CATEGORY III · 16 DAYS · OTORTEN · TEN SET OUT.

b2b.why: Ten names + ages as typographic roster (documented); group photo only if licence verified. Led by Dyatlov, 23; ages 20-38 per records.

b2c.motion: route polyline draws progressively; map crawl
b2c.why: ANCHOR: rail Ivdel → truck Vizhay → north up Lozva. YUDIN TURNS BACK — JAN 28 chip at the farewell point; farewell photo slot (licence permitting).

b2d.mode: route zoom + marker + diary line card
b2d.motion: zoom to Auspiya valley, marker pop
b2d.why: LABAZ (SUPPLY CACHE) marker in Auspiya valley; diary paraphrase card HARD FROST · WIND (documented, no invented quotes).

b2e.why: Planned line dashed to pass 1079 vs actual solid line drifting ~1 km west up Kholat Syakhl's shoulder. FEB 1 chip. The mistake made visible without asserting motive.

b2f.why: Slope 23° readout + TENT marker + FOREST EDGE 1.5 KM marker. Last-photo slot with honest credit; fallback stays terrain + markers (no fake 1959 photo).

b2g.why: THE DIARIES STOP. / THE PHOTOGRAPHS STOP. / NO WITNESS SURVIVED THE NIGHT. — the honest frame for all reconstruction that follows.

b3a.why: Search mobilization (volunteers, aircraft) Feb 20-26 grid overlay; tent-found chip FEB 26. Search-photo slot only with verified licence.

b3b.why: 8-9 slashes, some reachable only from within — numbered ticks + CUT FROM INSIDE band; prints chip 8-9 TRAILS, WALKING PACED.

b3c.motion: glow pulse at base, slow push
b3c.why: Cedar silhouette, small fire glow, branch-break markers; two memorial crosses at the base (restrained, no bodies). Names shown: DOROSHENKO / KRIVONISHENKO. Exposure + burned hands per autopsy.

b3c2.why: Branches broken to 5 m — height scale + SEARCHERS' NOTE: UNEXPLAINED. Keeps the documented mystery visible without speculating.

b3d.motion: markers land in sequence, line draws cedar->tent
b3d.why: Find positions along the return line with date chips (DYATLOV FEB 28 · SLOBODIN & KOLMOGOROVA MAR 5), memorial crosses only. All facing upslope per record.

b3e.why: Ravine + DEN markers, 75 m FROM CEDAR chip, 4 m snow gauge, EARLY MAY chip. Four names shown as memorial text only.

b3f.why: FIVE: EXPOSURE | FOUR: INTERNAL INJURIES; Slobodin chip SKULL FRACTURE — RULED NON-FATAL. Pure ledger content, icon-free.

b3g.why: SKULL: FRACTURE / CHEST: MULTIPLE FRACTURES / SKIN: UNBROKEN + FORCE WITHOUT A WOUND. No imagery of injuries — directive rule.

b3h.why: PARTLY UNDRESSED — TERMINAL HYPOOTHERMIA BEHAVIOUR (documented) | BETA CONTAMINATION — SOME GARMENTS, ORIGIN UNKNOWN. Facts that feed legends, stated as facts.

b3i.why: Documented closure phrase rendered as typographic quotation (not a fake scan): 'a compelling natural force which they were unable to overcome' — CASE CLOSED 28 MAY 1959.

b4a.why: Chapter frame: THE TEST IS THE EVIDENCE. Dark relief backdrop.

b4b.why: ATTACK — RULED OUT: no struggle / no third-party tracks / nothing stolen / Mansi cooperative. Crimson RULED OUT stamp.

b4c.why: ABANDONMENT — CONTRADICTED: boots/coats/food left; bodies along return line show attempts to survive.

b4d.motion: subtle sky glow arc, cards land
b4d.why: TESTIMONY ON FILE: glowing orange objects (witness statements incl. Atmanaki 7-8.IV.59) + BETA CONTAMINATION: REAL, UNEXPLAINED. Labelled testimony — nothing placed over the slope that night.

b4d2.why: Wind over ridge profile, low-frequency rings; card: FITS THE FEAR / NOT THE INJURIES / UNTESTABLE HERE — HYPOTHESIS. Fair treatment, clearly labelled.

b4e.why: Real slope map + cross-section profile with 23° marker; objection chips NO CROWN LINE / NO DEBRIS / NO ONE BURIED / SLOPE CLEAN AT DAY 26. The stalemate made visual.

b4f.why: JAN 2021 · ETH ZURICH · GAUME & PUZRIN + paper title chip (documented). The chapter turn.

b5a.why: Slope cross-section with the tent-platform cut drawn in (labelled: documented practice). Layered snowpack above.

b5b.why: Katabatic wind arrows over the shoulder, snow deposition accumulating above the tent marker; chip ARCTIC FRONT · KATABATIC WINDS.

b5c.motion: slab slides slow; readout counts 9.5–13 h
b5c.why: Weak layer + slab block sliding at walking pace onto tent; readout RELEASE WINDOW 9.5–13 H AFTER THE CUT; chip PRESSURE, NOT IMPACT.

b5c2.why: Tent + cut-out arrows + descent line to treeline; caption INJURED · FREEZING · ALIVE — FOR NOW. Model-based, labelled.

b5d.why: COMPRESSION → CHEST & SKULL, MODERATE-SEVERE, NON-FATAL + ticks ALL WALKED OUT / NONE BURIED. Maps model to autopsies without imagery.

b5e.why: 23° + WIND LOAD → RELEASE / TRACES ERASED BY SNOWFALL / 2022: THREE EXPEDITIONS · 'AVALANCHES NOT EXCEPTIONAL'. Paper-accurate wording.

b5f.why: WHY NO ONE RETURNED / WHY THE GROUP SPLIT / WHERE CONTAMINATION CAME FROM — three OPEN chips. Science's honest boundary.

b6a.why: STORM → LOAD → SLAB → EXIT → COLD chain card. The defensible synthesis.

b6b.why: PROSECUTORS 2020: AVALANCHE · DEATHS BY HYPOTHERMIA · NO CRIME. Requested by families (documented).

b6b2.why: Closure phrase callback + SCIENCE SPENT SIXTY YEARS NAMING IT.

b6c.why: THE CHOICES IN THE DARK — the human-sized remainder, stated without invention.

b6d.why: Nine names + ages on black, small cedar silhouette. No photographs of the deceased needed — respect + rights.

b6e.why: Dawn grade over the pass; THE FILE REMAINS OPEN; credit chip TERRAIN: MAPZEN/SRTM. Honest, restrained ending.

b6f.why: THE UNCLOSED FILE · DYATLOV PASS 1959 · sources line small.
